New patient

Option 1 — Read admission form: choose a photo or PDF and the app will fill the patient fields. The account number is handwritten, so type that one in yourself.

Option 2 — Save the admission form: photograph the form here, and/or choose an existing PDF. The app will make one PDF and attach it to this new patient's record when you save the patient.

Capture billing summary

For patients whose billing data you have (from a summary sheet or screenshot) but whose admission form hasn't been uploaded/filed yet. Paste the raw log text — you'll structure it into the Consultation Log when you merge it into a real patient record.

Daily batch entry

Start each day with all active patients. Remove anyone who was not seen that day, enter the Procedure code manually for everyone who remains, then merge the day's entries into the patient files.

The selected Dietician is automatically filled into every active patient's row. You can still change an individual row if needed.

Procedure codes are entered manually.

Scan document

Take or upload a photo of a Consultation File page (a printed patient PDF page — not a handwritten sheet). For a patient with more than one page of history, add each page below one at a time, then read them all together. The app reads them directly — nothing is sent anywhere.

OCR isn't perfect — check every field and every row below before saving, especially numbers.
